name: Commercial Lease Agreement
description: A formal commercial lease agreement document defining the terms, rent, and obligations between a landlord and a tenant.
key_questions: Who are the Landlord and Tenant parties to the lease?
What are the premises being leased?
What is the lease commencement and expiration date?
What is the annual base rent amount?
What is the stated recovery type (e.g., NNN)?
Are there any specific tenant improvement allowances specified?
